ideas.pitch: Smart waste sorting assistant using computer vision and LLMs to optimize neighborhood organic waste collection and composting efficiency.
ideas.title: CommunityCompost AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the Smart & Sustainable Future problem statement with a clear, measurable environmental benefit and localized community impact.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered voice app that matches elderly community members with local volunteers for errands and social visits.
ideas.title: ElderLink Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the exact pattern of Vanderbilt Global Good winner Outreach by solving a relatable social isolation pain point with clear community impact.

ideas.pitch: Browser extension and email scanner that detects sophisticated phishing tactics and multi-channel social engineering threats in real-time.
ideas.title: PhishingGuard AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Digital Safety & Cybersecurity track by addressing modern cyber threats that judges and everyday users face constantly.

ideas.pitch: Personalized meal planning assistant that suggests recipes utilizing surplus local grocery items to reduce food waste and improve diet.
ideas.title: LocalFood Nutrition & Waste AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines elements of nutrition tracking with sustainability, hitting both Everyday Life and Smart & Sustainable Future tracks effectively.

ideas.pitch: Offline-capable speech and language practice tool designed specifically to assist students with learning disabilities and speech impediments.
ideas.title: EduAccess Speech Tutor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Inclusive Technology track by improving educational accessibility through targeted AI speech analysis.
